attachments.origin_landmark: parotid fascia and the fascia over masseter
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin and mucosa at the angle of the mouth

actions: retracts the angle of the mouth laterally, producing a grimace

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Highly variable and sometimes absent. Purely fascial in origin -- it has no bony attachment.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
